description: B-365: start the campaign auto-runner directly at Infiltration (stage 0x2f) and dwell through the robot-heavy intro/AI tick window that Mike's build log crashed in at chrTickRobotAttack. This targets the exact auto-campaign path instead of relying on the longer first-cycle runner to reach Infiltration before its timeout.

input_sequence.comment: boot path: --auto-campaign 6 starts the campaign auto-runner at Infiltration.
the prior build crashed about six seconds after stage 0x2f became live; this dwell covers that robot AI tick window.

required_lines: GAMELOOP\.CAMPAIGN: playerReset begin playernum=0 role=bond stage=0x2f
forbidden_patterns: CAMPAIGN\.AUTO: endscreen still missing after retry
